material.description: Owner decision: no stashes, branches or hidden progress remain. For each stash entry, port its unique changes to origin main through a commit by explicit path (Git API), then drop the stash. Delete any local or remote branch after its commits are on main. Commit or retire the uncommitted tracked cache files so no lane keeps unversioned state (choose: untrack generated caches and ignore them). Acceptance: `git stash list` is empty, no branch except main exists locally or on origin, and no uncommitted tracked change remains in the shared checkout after a publish.

notes.note: Dispositions (gm-drain-1793526214-51). Published to origin/main: f936374a (moba.osdt OSDT v37 941680 B; duel-routes.osdt 18506 B); e1b451af (hy3d GLB re-encodes from stash@{8}). Dropped stashes: @{8} (on origin via e1b451af); @{0},@{1} (duel-routes equals origin; stash moba.osdt is an older regen superseded by f936374a); @{2..5} (only .gm and .agentplug-kv runtime caches). Kept stashes (3): b83363b2 (2026-10-27; 16 paths apply cleanly, 13 conflict with later origin work, e.g. panels.lua 126 added lines absent from origin); 6805baa5 (2026-10-21; 27 conflicting paths, deletes js/client/hud5.js, lobby.js, ui_*.js); 31ac6bcd (2026-10-17; 65 paths, mass deletions of rust/crates/sim code origin still has). Partial Rust ports cannot be built (no cargo), so not ported. Branch origin/claude/wonderful-hopper-xzvxvx kept: 20+ unique Oct 17 commits on a divergent tree; not ported, not deleted. Working tree: other modified tracked paths equal origin/main; untracked bota/, 247420/, rust/gate/src/* equal origin. Not ported: rust/gate/src/mechanic_checks.rs (origin and working tree rewrite the same gate helpers; test file), closes/prop-pack-all-props.txt (working copy empty), scenarios/moba/provenance/units_688g_creep_summons.osd.tsv (origin superset), js/client/vendor/wireweave (submodule content dirty, pin unchanged). Not done: step 5 cache untrack (publish_on_origin publishes only existing files). Local main 1 ahead (e56dd0b6) and behind origin; not pulled (dirty tree).
